The designer must update the title block heat treatment field to reflect the case hardening requirement in N3.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from \"N.A.\" to reference the case hardening specified in note N3."},{"rule_id":"WPM-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 calls out case hardening but no dimension or view on the drawing marks the specific area to be hardened (e.g., with cross-hatching or an XXXXX boundary). Without this, the heat treater cannot know which surfaces require the 55–60 HRC case and which must remain soft beyond the threads mentioned. The designer should add a hatched or marked zone on the views indicating exactly where the case hardening applies.","recommended_correction":"Add a clearly marked area (cross-hatching or boundary) on the drawing views showing where the case hardening per N3 is to be applied."}]}
